statement: The package command metadata and lockfile expose lagrange through src/sea-entry.js while preserving the existing lagrange-admin binary.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The only product metadata paths in scope are package.json and package-lock.json. Both map lagrange to src/sea-entry.js and preserve lagrange-admin at src/cli/bin/lagrange-admin.js; no source, test, runtime, dependency, script, export, version, or other package metadata change is in scope.

The root package declaration and root lockfile package declaration expose identical binary names and targets, and the service-init-scaffold scenario is the behavioral oracle for the shipped entrypoint.

Independent verification must show that removing either lagrange mapping fails the package-entrypoint assertion and must verify the exact two-file patch plus aggregate content before checkpoint and handoff.
